snippet.title: The Dinosaur Skeleton MOVED Closer Every NIGHT 🦖😱
snippet.description:
Every night, the T-rex skeleton in her mom's museum crept a little closer to her cot… Her mom is the night guard, so she sleeps right there in the dinosaur hall. On the third morning, every skeleton in the hall had turned to face her. That night, she kept her flashlight on the T-rex, because as long as it was in the light, it couldn't move… until her flashlight started to flicker. 🦖😱

It was never coming for her.

snippet.title: Ranking what parents do for kids' sports #youthsports #sportsparents #sportsmedicine
snippet.description:
What sport or sports does your kid play? Tell me below.

Is your kid playing too much? It's one of the questions parents ask me most, and the answer is often yes.

Kids have growth plates near the ends of their bones, and those areas are weaker than the bone and tendons around them. That's why young athletes get injuries adults don't, like heel pain in growing soccer players or elbow pain in young pitchers.

A few warning signs worth taking seriously:

Pain at the start of practice, not just at the end.

Limping, or changing how they run or throw.

Pain in the same spot every season.

Swelling, or a joint that won't straighten all the way.

They don't want to play anymore. Burnout is real, and it often shows up before the injury does.

A few things that help: at least one or two days off a week, a few months a year away from their main sport, and plenty of sleep.

And if your kid throws, follow the pitch counts and rest days for their age. They exist for a reason.

As a dad of four boys, I ranked what parents do for kids' sports in the video. The rule I end on is the one I'd want every parent to know.

What sport or sports does your kid play? Tell me below.

Is your kid playing too much? It's one of the questions parents ask me most, and the answer is often yes.

Kids have growth plates near the ends of their bones, and those areas are weaker than the bone and tendons around them. That's why young athletes get injuries adults don't, like heel pain in growing soccer players or elbow pain in young pitchers.

A few warning signs worth taking seriously:

Pain at the start of practice, not just at the end.

Limping, or changing how they run or throw.

Pain in the same spot every season.

Swelling, or a joint that won't straighten all the way.

They don't want to play anymore. Burnout is real, and it often shows up before the injury does.

A few things that help: at least one or two days off a week, a few months a year away from their main sport, and plenty of sleep.

And if your kid throws, follow the pitch counts and rest days for their age. They exist for a reason.

As a dad of four boys, I ranked what parents do for kids' sports in the video. The rule I end on is the one I'd want every parent to know.

snippet.title: Beautiful Healer Is Hunted Into the Bear Forest… but the Beast With Human Eyes Hides Her
snippet.description:
When the jarl’s son dies of fever in Liv’s care, her fate is sealed. Branded a witch and hunted through the snow, the desperate healer runs for the one realm forbidden to mankind for fifteen winters: the Bear Forest, marked by ancient bone totems.

The jarl stops at the border, sending his relentless huntsman, Ulf, and a pack of trackers into the trees to finish the hunt.

Inside the frozen grove, the rules of men no longer apply. Tracks dwarf human footprints, deep claw marks scar the birches far out of reach, and the hunters begin vanishing into the mist. When Liv plunges through cracking ice, an unseen protector casts a lifeline from the shadows.

At twilight, the legendary beast finally steps forward: the silhouette of a bear, but the piercing eyes of a man. Instead of claiming her life, it shields her—and on its wrist rests a woven red knot matching the one Liv wears herself.

They hunted the healer into the forbidden forest… but the creature everyone feared became her only salvation. And Ulf knows far more about the curse of these woods than he lets on.

snippet.description:
■“雲海”観光地で殺人未遂事件

　事件が起きたのは北海道の雲海で有名な公園です。

　訪れた53歳の男性は絶景を眺めていたところ、突然、軽トラックが…。その時、運転していた男が大声を上げているのが聞えたといいます。

　男性をはね、車はそのまま斜面を10メートルほど転落しました。

　ところが、これで終わりではなく、男は斜面をバールを持って上がってきたというのです。全く知らない男でした。

　バールで男性に殴り掛かってきたといい、さらに押し倒し、馬乗りになって暴行したとみられています。

　男性は右肩甲骨を折るなどの重傷です。

　4日に殺人未遂の疑いで逮捕されたのは、住所不定・職業不詳の今野康幸容疑者（54）です。

今野容疑者の供述
「わざとじゃない、アクセルとブレーキを踏み間違えたかもしれない。バールは相手に殴られそうになったから構えた」

　今野容疑者は覚醒剤取締法違反などの疑いでも摘発されています。

snippet.title: 90 Feet Hanuman shocks Trump: हनुमान प्रतिमा ने ट्रंप को हराया ! 36 साल बाद अमेरिका में हड़कंप !
snippet.description:
मिडटर्म चुनाव में हार के बाद राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प की रिपब्लिकन पार्टी में अंदरूनी नाराजगी सामने आने लगी है। टेक्सास के रिपब्लिकन नेता चैड विलबैंक्स ने ईरान युद्ध, टैरिफ और रूस के राष्ट्रपति पुतिन का पक्ष लेने वाले ट्रम्प के फैसलों को हार की वजह बताया। इसी बीच टेक्सास (अमेरिका) के शुगर लैंड स्थित श्री अष्टलक्ष्मी मंदिर में स्थापित भगवान हनुमान की 90 फुट ऊंची प्रतिमा का मुद्दा फिर जिन्दा हो गया, चुनाव से पहले रिपब्लिकन पार्टी से जुड़े कुछ नेताओं और सीनेट उम्मीदवारों (जैसे अलेक्जेंडर डंकन) ने भी बयान दिया कि हम एक ईसाई देश में "एक झूठी हिंदू देवता की मूर्ति" को यहां क्यों रहने दे रहे हैं। मगर इसी टेक्सास को डोनाल्ड ट्रंप और रिपब्लिकन पार्टी की सबसे बड़ी हार (Biggest Defeat) इसलिए कहा जा रहा है क्योंकि 2026 के अमेरिकी मध्यावधि (Midterm) चुनावों में डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी ने रिपब्लिकन पार्टी के सबसे मजबूत और पारंपरिक गढ़ "टेक्सास" को पूरी तरह ढहा दिया है। 

Following the defeat in the midterm elections, internal discontent has begun to surface within President Trump’s Republican Party. Chad Wilbanks, a Republican leader from Texas, attributed the loss to Trump’s decisions—specifically regarding a potential war with Iran, the imposition of tariffs, and his favorable stance toward Russian President Vladimir Putin. Meanwhile, the issue surrounding a 90-foot-tall statue of Lord Hanuman—installed at the Sri Ashtalakshmi Temple in Sugar Land, Texas—has resurfaced; prior to the election, certain figures associated with the Republican Party, including Senate candidates like Alexander Duncan, questioned why a "statue of a false Hindu deity" was being permitted to remain in what they termed a "Christian nation." However, Texas is being cited as the site of the most significant defeat for Donald Trump and the Republican Party, as the Democratic Party has effectively dismantled the GOP’s strongest and most traditional stronghold in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections.

मिडटर्म चुनाव में हार के बाद राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प की रिपब्लिकन पार्टी में अंदरूनी नाराजगी सामने आने लगी है। टेक्सास के रिपब्लिकन नेता चैड विलबैंक्स ने ईरान युद्ध, टैरिफ और रूस के राष्ट्रपति पुतिन का पक्ष लेने वाले ट्रम्प के फैसलों को हार की वजह बताया। इसी बीच टेक्सास (अमेरिका) के शुगर लैंड स्थित श्री अष्टलक्ष्मी मंदिर में स्थापित भगवान हनुमान की 90 फुट ऊंची प्रतिमा का मुद्दा फिर जिन्दा हो गया, चुनाव से पहले रिपब्लिकन पार्टी से जुड़े कुछ नेताओं और सीनेट उम्मीदवारों (जैसे अलेक्जेंडर डंकन) ने भी बयान दिया कि हम एक ईसाई देश में "एक झूठी हिंदू देवता की मूर्ति" को यहां क्यों रहने दे रहे हैं। मगर इसी टेक्सास को डोनाल्ड ट्रंप और रिपब्लिकन पार्टी की सबसे बड़ी हार (Biggest Defeat) इसलिए कहा जा रहा है क्योंकि 2026 के अमेरिकी मध्यावधि (Midterm) चुनावों में डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी ने रिपब्लिकन पार्टी के सबसे मजबूत और पारंपरिक गढ़ "टेक्सास" को पूरी तरह ढहा दिया है। 

Following the defeat in the midterm elections, internal discontent has begun to surface within President Trump’s Republican Party. Chad Wilbanks, a Republican leader from Texas, attributed the loss to Trump’s decisions—specifically regarding a potential war with Iran, the imposition of tariffs, and his favorable stance toward Russian President Vladimir Putin. Meanwhile, the issue surrounding a 90-foot-tall statue of Lord Hanuman—installed at the Sri Ashtalakshmi Temple in Sugar Land, Texas—has resurfaced; prior to the election, certain figures associated with the Republican Party, including Senate candidates like Alexander Duncan, questioned why a "statue of a false Hindu deity" was being permitted to remain in what they termed a "Christian nation." However, Texas is being cited as the site of the most significant defeat for Donald Trump and the Republican Party, as the Democratic Party has effectively dismantled the GOP’s strongest and most traditional stronghold in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections.
